notes: Every node is its own malloc; a leaf has two null children.
Each tree is freed right after its check by a recursive free_tree: one free per node (glibc malloc, static).
Digits are validated before strtoull, which alone would accept a sign or leading spaces.
gcc -std=c23 -O2, statically linked and stripped, running on a scratch image; stdout fully buffered by setvbuf (64 KiB).
